verses.original: הִנָּ֨ךְ יָפָ֤ה רַעְיָתִי֙ הִנָּ֣ךְ יָפָ֔ה עֵינַ֣יִךְ יוֹנִ֔ים מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵ֑ךְ שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּלְשׁ֖וּ מֵהַ֥ר גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nāḵ yā·p̄āh ra‘·yā·ṯî hin·nāḵ yā·p̄āh ‘ê·na·yiḵ yō·w·nîm mib·ba·‘aḏ lə·ṣam·mā·ṯêḵ śa‘·rêḵ kə·‘ê·ḏer hā·‘iz·zîm šeg·gā·lə·šū mê·har gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: How beautiful [you are] my darling how very beautiful Your eyes are [like] doves behind your veil Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down Mount Gilead

verses.original: שִׁנַּ֙יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הַקְּצוּב֔וֹת שֶׁעָל֖וּ מִן־ הָרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃ וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: šin·na·yiḵ kə·‘ê·ḏer haq·qə·ṣū·ḇō·wṯ še·‘ā·lū min- hā·raḥ·ṣāh šek·kul·lām maṯ·’î·mō·wṯ ’ên bā·hem wə·šak·ku·lāh
verses.literal: Your teeth are like a flock of newly shorn sheep coming up from the washing each has its twin and not one of them [is] lost

verses.original: שִׂפְתֹתַ֔יִךְ הַשָּׁנִי֙ כְּח֤וּט וּמִדְבָּרֵ֖יךְ נָאוֶ֑ה רַקָּתֵ֔ךְ מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ׃ כְּפֶ֤לַח הָֽרִמּוֹן֙
verses.transliteration: śip̄·ṯō·ṯa·yiḵ haš·šā·nî kə·ḥūṭ ū·miḏ·bā·rêḵ nā·weh raq·qā·ṯêḵ mib·ba·‘aḏ lə·ṣam·mā·ṯêḵ kə·p̄e·laḥ hā·rim·mō·wn
verses.literal: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon and your mouth is lovely Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate

verses.original: צַוָּארֵ֔ךְ כְּמִגְדַּ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ בָּנ֖וּי לְתַלְפִּיּ֑וֹת עָלָ֔יו תָּל֣וּי אֶ֤לֶף הַמָּגֵן֙ כֹּ֖ל שִׁלְטֵ֥י הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw·wā·rêḵ kə·miḡ·dal dā·wîḏ bā·nui lə·ṯal·pî·yō·wṯ ‘ā·lāw tā·lui ’e·lep̄ ham·mā·ḡên kōl šil·ṭê hag·gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: Your neck is like the tower of David built with rows of stones on it hang a thousand shields all of them shields of warriors

verses.original: שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י שְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תְּאוֹמֵ֣י צְבִיָּ֑ה הָרוֹעִ֖ים בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ḏa·yiḵ kiš·nê šə·nê ‘o·p̄ā·rîm tə·’ō·w·mê ṣə·ḇî·yāh hā·rō·w·‘îm baš·šō·wō·šan·nîm
verses.literal: Your breasts . . . are like two fawns twins of a gazelle grazing among the lilies

verses.original: עַ֤ד הַיּ֔וֹם שֶׁיָּפ֙וּחַ֙ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים וְנָ֖סוּ אֵ֤לֶךְ לִי֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר הַמּ֔וֹר וְאֶל־ גִּבְעַ֖ת הַלְּבוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm še·yā·p̄ū·aḥ haṣ·ṣə·lā·lîm wə·nā·sū ’ê·leḵ lî ’el- har ham·mō·wr wə·’el- giḇ·‘aṯ hal·lə·ḇō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Before the day breaks and the shadows flee I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh . . . and to the hill of frankincense

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י בָּֽךְ׃ס אֵ֥ין וּמ֖וּם
verses.literal: You are altogether beautiful my darling in you [there is] no flaw

verses.original: תָּב֑וֹאִי אִתִּ֤י מִלְּבָנוֹן֙ כַּלָּ֔ה אִתִּ֖י מִלְּבָנ֣וֹן תָּשׁ֣וּרִי׀ מֵרֹ֣אשׁ אֲמָנָ֗ה מֵרֹ֤אשׁ שְׂנִיר֙ וְחֶרְמ֔וֹן מִמְּעֹנ֣וֹת אֲרָי֔וֹת מֵֽהַרְרֵ֖י נְמֵרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: tā·ḇō·w·’î ’it·tî mil·lə·ḇā·nō·wn kal·lāh ’it·tî mil·lə·ḇā·nō·wn tā·šū·rî mê·rōš ’ă·mā·nāh mê·rōš śə·nîr wə·ḥer·mō·wn mim·mə·‘ō·nō·wṯ ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ mê·har·rê nə·mê·rîm
verses.literal: Come with me from Lebanon my bride [come] with me from Lebanon Descend from the peak of Amana from the summits of Senir and Hermon from the dens of the lions from the mountains of the leopards

verses.original: לִבַּבְתִּ֖נִי אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה לִבַּבְתִּ֙ינִי֙ בְּאַחַד מֵעֵינַ֔יִךְ בְּאַחַ֥ד עֲנָ֖ק מִצַּוְּרֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lib·baḇ·ti·nî ’ă·ḥō·ṯî ḵal·lāh lib·baḇ·tî·nî bə·ʾa·ḥaḏ mê·‘ê·na·yiḵ bə·’a·ḥaḏ ‘ă·nāq miṣ·ṣaw·wə·rō·nā·yiḵ
verses.literal: You have captured my heart my sister my bride you have stolen my heart with one glance of your eyes with one jewel of your neck

verses.original: מַה־ יָּפ֥וּ דֹדַ֖יִךְ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה דֹדַ֙יִךְ֙ מַה־ טֹּ֤בוּ מִיַּ֔יִן וְרֵ֥יחַ שְׁמָנַ֖יִךְ מִכָּל־ בְּשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mah- yā·p̄ū ḏō·ḏa·yiḵ ’ă·ḥō·ṯî ḵal·lāh ḏō·ḏa·yiḵ mah- ṭō·ḇū mî·ya·yin wə·rê·aḥ šə·mā·na·yiḵ mik·kāl bə·śā·mîm
verses.literal: How delightful [is] your love my sister my bride Your love is much better than wine and the fragrance of your perfume than all spices

verses.original: שִׂפְתוֹתַ֖יִךְ כַּלָּ֑ה תִּטֹּ֥פְנָה נֹ֛פֶת דְּבַ֤שׁ וְחָלָב֙ תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְרֵ֥יחַ שַׂלְמֹתַ֖יִךְ כְּרֵ֥יחַ לְבָנֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: śip̄·ṯō·w·ṯa·yiḵ kal·lāh tiṭ·ṭō·p̄ə·nāh nō·p̄eṯ də·ḇaš wə·ḥā·lāḇ ta·ḥaṯ lə·šō·w·nêḵ wə·rê·aḥ śal·mō·ṯa·yiḵ kə·rê·aḥ lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: Your lips my bride drip sweetness like the honeycomb honey and milk are under your tongue and the fragrance of your garments is like the aroma of Lebanon

verses.original: אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה גַּ֥ן׀ נָע֖וּל גַּ֥ל נָע֖וּל מַעְיָ֥ן חָתֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḥō·ṯî ḵal·lāh gan nā·‘ūl gal nā·‘ūl ma‘·yān ḥā·ṯūm
verses.literal: My sister my bride [you are] a garden locked up a spring enclosed a fountain sealed

verses.original: שְׁלָחַ֙יִךְ֙ פַּרְדֵּ֣ס רִמּוֹנִ֔ים עִ֖ם מְגָדִ֑ים פְּרִ֣י כְּפָרִ֖ים עִם־ נְרָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lā·ḥa·yiḵ par·dês rim·mō·w·nîm ‘im mə·ḡā·ḏîm pə·rî kə·p̄ā·rîm ‘im- nə·rā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Your branches [are] an orchard of pomegranates with the choicest of fruits with henna [and] nard

verses.original: נֵ֣רְדְּ׀ וְכַרְכֹּ֗ם קָנֶה֙ וְקִנָּמ֔וֹן עִ֖ם כָּל־ לְבוֹנָ֑ה עֲצֵ֣י מֹ֚ר וַאֲהָל֔וֹת עִ֖ם כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nê·rəd wə·ḵar·kōm qā·neh wə·qin·nā·mō·wn ‘im kāl- lə·ḇō·w·nāh ‘ă·ṣê mōr wa·’ă·hā·lō·wṯ ‘im kāl- rā·šê ḇə·śā·mîm
verses.literal: with nard and saffron [with] calamus and cinnamon with every kind of frankincense tree with myrrh and aloes with all the finest spices

verses.original: גַּנִּ֔ים מַעְיַ֣ן בְּאֵ֖ר חַיִּ֑ים מַ֣יִם וְנֹזְלִ֖ים מִן־ לְבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: gan·nîm ma‘·yan bə·’êr ḥay·yîm ma·yim wə·nō·zə·lîm min- lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: You are a garden spring a well of fresh water flowing down from Lebanon

verses.original: ע֤וּרִי צָפוֹן֙ וּב֣וֹאִי תֵימָ֔ן הָפִ֥יחִי גַנִּ֖י יִזְּל֣וּ בְשָׂמָ֑יו דוֹדִי֙ יָבֹ֤א לְגַנּ֔וֹ וְיֹאכַ֖ל מְגָדָֽיו׃ פְּרִ֥י
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·rî ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·ḇō·w·’î ṯê·mān hā·p̄î·ḥî ḡan·nî yiz·zə·lū ḇə·śā·māw ḏō·w·ḏî yā·ḇō lə·ḡan·nōw wə·yō·ḵal mə·ḡā·ḏāw pə·rî
verses.literal: Awake O north wind and come O south wind Breathe on my garden and spread the fragrance of its spices Let my beloved come into his garden and taste its choicest fruits
